highlights: The earnings upside was largely driven by NPC's significant contribution of 40% to consolidated revenue and improved margin.
MAN subsidiary National Pipe Company (NPC) reported revenue of INR 4.8 Bn this quarter as compared to INR 430 Mn in Q1FY27, with 45% capacity utilisation and an EBITDA margin of 18%.
The current order book stands at INR 35 Bn, with a bid book of INR 190 Bn.

Our positive stance is underpinned by: 1) Strong Earnings Trajectory: We forecast Revenue / EBITDA / PAT CAGR of 31% / 42% / 61% over FY26–29E, respectively, supported by a strong order book and a healthy bid pipeline 2) Balance Sheet Upside from Non-core Asset Monetisation: Monetisation of Navi Mumbai land parcel is likely to generate INR 7–8 Bn/year cash inflow for the next 3–5 years.
